1ce76aacae8cf3e190e7528b7b98ab6465de83f7:
query Me {
  me {
    id
    email
    name
    displayName
    username
    profilePictureUrl
    profilePictureId
    onboardingComplete
    biddingAllowed
    isEmailVerified
    status
    userRole
    dob
    location {
      displayName
      latitude
      longitude
      zipCode
    }
    skills {
      id
      name
    }
    mobileNumber
    lastLoginAt
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}

mutation UpdateUserProfile($input: UpdateUserProfileInput!) {
  updateUserProfile(input: $input) {
    id
    username
    displayName
    name
    email
    profilePictureUrl
    profilePictureId
    onboardingComplete
    userRole
    location {
      displayName
      latitude
      longitude
      zipCode
    }
    lastLoginAt
    isEmailVerified
    status
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}
